queries.sqlShape: UPDATE instagram_http_attempts SET payload_json=json_set(payload_json,'?',NULL) WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE requested_at<? AND json_extract(payload_json,'?') IS NOT NULL LIMIT ?)
DELETE FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE requested_at<? LIMIT ?)

SELECT
 (SELECT enabled FROM collection_policy_history WHERE account_id=? AND effective_to IS NULL ORDER BY effective_from DESC LIMIT ?) enabled,
 (SELECT policy_json FROM collection_policy_history WHERE account_id=? AND effective_to IS NULL ORDER BY effective_from DESC LIMIT 1) policy_json,
 (SELECT expires_at FROM instagram_connections WHERE account_id=?) grantExpiresAt,
 (SELECT scopes FROM instagram_connections WHERE account_id=?) scopes,
 (SELECT json_extract(payload_json,'?') FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE account_id=? ORDER BY requested_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) lastResult

SELECT json_extract(payload_json,'?') AS "from",json_extract(payload_json,'?') AS "to",MAX(observed_at) AS observedAt FROM account_insights
       WHERE account_id=? AND observed_at>=? AND json_extract(payload_json,'?')='?'
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(payload_json,'?') v WHERE json_extract(v.value,'?')='?')
         AND json_extract(payload_json,'?')=? AND json_extract(payload_json,'?')='?'
         AND json_extract(payload_json,'?')=? AND json_extract(payload_json,'?')='?'
         AND json_extract(payload_json,'?') IS NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(?) needed WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(account_insights.payload_json,'?') saved WHERE saved.value=needed.value))
       GROUP BY json_extract(payload_json,'?'),json_extract(payload_json,'?')

WITH targets(hours,tolerance) AS (VALUES (?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?),(?,?))
         SELECT m.id AS mediaId,t.hours AS targetHours,
           m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000 AS deadline
         FROM media m CROSS JOIN targets t
         WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='?' AND m.unavailable_until<=?
           AND m.published_at+t.hours*3600000<=?
           AND m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000>=?
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_snapshots s WHERE s.media_id=m.id
             AND s.observed_at BETWEEN m.published_at+(t.hours-t.tolerance)*3600000
               AND m.published_at+(t.hours+t.tolerance)*3600000 AND json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?') IS NOT NULL)
         ORDER BY deadline,m.published_at,m.id,t.hours LIMIT ?

SELECT m.id FROM media m LEFT JOIN media_snapshots s ON s.id=(SELECT latest.id FROM media_snapshots latest WHERE latest.media_id=m.id ORDER BY latest.observed_at DESC LIMIT ?)
      WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='?' AND m.unavailable_until<=? AND (m.unavailable_code IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(s.metrics_json) metric WHERE json_extract(metric.value,'?')='?') OR COALESCE(s.observed_at,0) <= ? - CASE WHEN ?-m.published_at < 2*86400000 THEN 3600000 WHEN ?-m.published_at < 8*86400000 THEN 21600000 WHEN ?-m.published_at < 31*86400000 THEN 86400000 ELSE 604800000 END)
      ORDER BY COALESCE(s.observed_at,0),m.published_at DESC LIMIT 1

WITH observed AS (
      SELECT s.media_id,MAX(s.observed_at) lastSuccess,
        MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(s.metrics_json) v WHERE json_extract(v.value,'?') IS NOT NULL) OR json_extract(s.story_insights_json,'?') IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(s.story_insights_json,'?') v WHERE json_extract(v.value,'?') IS NOT NULL) THEN s.observed_at END) lastUsefulObservation,
        SUM(s.provenance_json IS NULL) legacyProvenanceUnknown
      FROM media_snapshots s JOIN media m ON m.id=s.media_id WHERE m.account_id=? GROUP BY s.media_id
    ),attempted AS (
      SELECT object_id,MAX(requested_at) lastAttempt,MAX(CASE WHEN json_extract(payload_json,'?')='?' THEN received_at END) lastCheck FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE account_id=? GROUP BY object_id
    ) SELECT m.product_type kind,COUNT(*) objects,MAX(a.lastAttempt) lastAttempt,MAX(a.lastCheck) lastCheck,MAX(o.lastSuccess) lastSuccess,MAX(o.lastUsefulObservation) lastUsefulObservation,COALESCE(SUM(o.legacyProvenanceUnknown),0) legacyProvenanceUnknown
      FROM media m LEFT JOIN observed o ON o.media_id=m.id LEFT JOIN attempted a ON a.object_id=m.external_id WHERE m.account_id=? GROUP BY m.product_type

SELECT
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sync_runs WHERE account_id=? AND status='?' AND lease_expires_at<=?) expiredSyncAttempts,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_insights WHERE account_id=? AND json_extract(payload_json,'?')='?' AND json_extract(payload_json,'?')<=?) expiredInsightAttempts,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_collections c JOIN media m ON m.id=c.media_id WHERE m.account_id=? AND json_extract(c.result_json,'?')='?' AND json_extract(c.result_json,'?')<=?) expiredCommentAttempts,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_jobs WHERE account_id=? AND lease_expires_at>?) leasesInUse

SELECT m.id FROM media m LEFT JOIN media_snapshots s ON s.id=(SELECT latest.id FROM media_snapshots latest WHERE latest.media_id=m.id ORDER BY latest.observed_at DESC LIMIT ?)
      WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='?' AND m.unavailable_until<=? AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(s.metrics_json) metric WHERE json_extract(metric.value,'?')='?') OR COALESCE(s.observed_at,0) <= ? - CASE WHEN ?-m.published_at < 2*86400000 THEN 3600000 WHEN ?-m.published_at < 8*86400000 THEN 21600000 WHEN ?-m.published_at < 31*86400000 THEN 86400000 ELSE 604800000 END)
      ORDER BY COALESCE(s.observed_at,0),m.published_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT recorded_requests AS recordedRequests,since_at AS sinceAt,usage_percent AS usagePercent,usage_observed_at AS usageObservedAt,blocked_until AS blockedUntil,observed_at AS observedAt,attempts,responses,failures_before_response AS failuresBeforeResponse,timeouts,rate_limited_responses AS rateLimitedResponses,accounting_since_at AS accountingSinceAt,usage_headers_json AS usageHeadersJson,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instagram_metric_support WHERE account_id=? AND api_version=? AND expires_at>?) AS cachedUnavailableMetrics FROM instagram_api_state WHERE id=?
SELECT media_id mediaId,observed_at observedAt,json_extract(metrics_json,'?') IS NOT NULL usable FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id IN (SELECT id FROM media WHERE account_id=?) AND observed_at<=?

SELECT m.id,m.published_at AS publishedAt FROM media m LEFT JOIN comment_media_state s ON s.media_id=m.id
       WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='?' AND m.published_at<=?
         AND COALESCE(s.unavailable_until,0)<=?
         AND (s.media_id IS NOT NULL OR m.published_at>?-720*3600000 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE account_id=m.account_id AND origin='?' AND status='?'))
         AND (s.media_id IS NULL OR s.next_refresh_at<=? OR s.event_generation>s.processed_generation OR (s.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL AND s.last_comments_count IS NOT (SELECT json_extract(metrics_json,'?') FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT ?)))
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE target_media_id=m.id AND origin='?' AND status='?')
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE target_media_id=m.id AND origin='?' AND error_code IS NOT NULL AND next_attempt_at>?)
       ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.event_generation>s.processed_generation THEN 0 WHEN s.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL AND s.last_comments_count IS NOT (SELECT json_extract(metrics_json,'?') FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
         CASE WHEN m.published_at>?-72*3600000 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,COALESCE(s.next_refresh_at,0),m.published_at DESC,m.id LIMIT 1

SELECT json_extract(payload_json,'?') family,json_extract(payload_json,'?') status,json_extract(payload_json,'?') result,json_extract(payload_json,'?') graph_code,json_extract(payload_json,'?') graph_subcode,COUNT(*) n,MAX(requested_at) last_at FROM instagram_http_attempts WHERE requested_at>=? GROUP BY family,status,result,graph_code,graph_subcode

SELECT MIN(m.published_at+86400000) AS expiry FROM media m
      WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type='?' AND m.published_at+86400000>?
        AND COALESCE((SELECT observed_at FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT ?),0)<m.published_at+86400000-900000

SELECT MIN(m.published_at+86400000) AS expiry FROM media m
      WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type='?' AND m.published_at+86400000>?
        AND COALESCE((SELECT observed_at FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT ?),0)<m.published_at+86400000-?
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs j WHERE j.account_id=m.account_id
          AND j.origin='?' AND COALESCE(j.last_attempt_at,j.started_at)>?)
